document: Foreign (non-Hungarian) supplier invoice; the buyer is typically a Hungarian company; the language may be English, Hungarian (localized), German, Polish or Turkish

field_specs.supplier_name: name of the SUPPLIER, the party that issues the invoice (From / Issuer / Seller / legal footer block), as printed; may be a private person (freelancer)
field_specs.supplier_tax_id: the supplier's FOREIGN tax / VAT identification number exactly as printed (EU VAT number such as IE8256796U, Turkish VKN / TCKN, Polish NIP, US EIN) - not the Hungarian buyer's HU-prefixed number
field_specs.supplier_address: postal address of the supplier (issuer), as printed
field_specs.supplier_country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the SUPPLIER (issuer), inferred from its address or tax-id prefix (IE, US, DE, PL, TR, ...) - not the buyer's country
field_specs.buyer_name: name of the BUYER, the party that receives the invoice (Bill to / Customer / Vevő / Számlafizető), typically a Hungarian company
field_specs.buyer_tax_id: the buyer's tax / VAT identification number exactly as printed (typically HU-prefixed, e.g. HU28994028, or Hungarian ########-#-##)
field_specs.buyer_address: postal address of the buyer (Bill to / Vevő block), as printed
field_specs.invoice_number: the invoice's own document number (Invoice No / #, Fatura No, Belge No, Rechnungsnummer, Számla száma), not an order number, UUID, customer id, tax id or bank account
field_specs.issue_date: issue date (Date, Invoice date, Fatura Tarihi, Számla dátuma), ISO format
field_specs.due_date: payment due date (Due date, Vade, Határidő), ISO format; often absent on e-tickets and card-charged invoices
field_specs.currency: ISO 4217 code of the invoice's BILLING currency (TL = TRY; a HUF tax-reporting conversion is not the billing currency)
field_specs.net_total: invoice-level net total before VAT in the billing currency (Subtotal, Mal Hizmet Tutarı, Terhelések összesen áfa nélkül); null when the invoice prints no explicit net line
field_specs.vat_total: invoice-level VAT / KDV total; 0 for reverse-charge, 0 % or tax-exempt invoices
field_specs.gross_total: invoice-level gross total = the final payable amount including all taxes in the billing currency (Total, Total due, Ödenecek Tutar, Végösszeg)
field_specs.payment_iban: the supplier's or the named beneficiary's bank account / IBAN printed for paying this invoice, exactly as printed; null if none or several different ones
